headline: 15 million players
title: Aniimo Hits 15 Million Players | Season 1 Part 2 | Aniimo News
video_script: Aniimo has passed fifteen million players, says Pawprint Studio, just as Season One Part Two went live on October twenty ninth. Part Two adds fifty one new Aniimo, thirty two of them brand new species, plus Prismana forms like Whirlbite and Sugartini. It also raises the level cap to seventy and adds the Whisperwake Isles map. Are you playing Part Two? Comment below!
description: Pawprint Studio says Aniimo has passed 15 million players. Season 1 Part 2 (October 29) adds 51 new Aniimo, 32 new species, Prismana forms and a level cap of 70.
